sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders will be heavy favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive on the back of a losing run. Sandbach's recent form shows a single loss followed by four wins and a draw, so they will be looking to bounce back from that defeat.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third and unbeaten in their last two, welcome Eccleshall (sixth place, currently on a winning run) in what shapes as a competitive clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in-form with three consecutive wins, face Wednesfield Community at home before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town (fifth, on a three-game winning streak) travel to face Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United — the latter enduring a run of six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills, with both sides looking to climb the table after mixed recent form. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a battle between sides near the bottom, Crewe take on Allscott Heath (who have won their last two), and Brereton Social visit Widnes Town on Saturday afternoon in a fixture between struggling sides.
